description.value: Daystar Market is a long-established organic and specialty grocery store on Galiano Island that has served islanders and visitors since 1976. It stocks a wide range of organic and conventional produce, dairy, specialty meats, bulk spices, local BC products, gluten-free, and vegan options — making it the primary resupply stop for cyclists touring the Gulf Islands. The store changed hands in October 2025 and continues to operate year-round.

address.value: 96 Georgeson Bay Road, Galiano Island, BC V0N 1P0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content fully corroborates the OSM contact details (phone, address, website) and confirms the store is open year-round under new ownership as of October 2025. The FAQ page explicitly states 'No' to a public washroom and confirms no mention of bike parking or water refill. The OSM 'community' field lists 'Tsawwassen' but the website clearly places this business on Galiano Island, BC — a significant location discrepancy worth flagging, as Tsawwassen is the mainland BC Ferries terminal.
concerns: OSM 'community' field is set to 'Tsawwassen' (a mainland BC Ferries terminal), but the business is clearly located on Galiano Island, BC — the website address and all content confirm Galiano Island. The OSM community tag appears to be incorrect.
Solomon Rose Cafe & Gallery, formerly co-located inside the market, is listed as '[Closed Indefinitely]' on the website — the hot food/espresso amenity associated with it is unavailable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible grocery store on Galiano Island operating since 1976; confirmed open under new ownership as of October 2025 and the primary resupply option for cyclists on the island.

Washrooms.detail: FAQ explicitly states: 'Does the Market have a public washroom? No. The closest public washroom is located a couple blocks away at the Recycling Depot.'
